heading: Bed board
description: Every bed in use by ward and status, and who is in it. Cleaning, ready and blocked are set here.

live.retrying: Reconnecting. Meanwhile the board refreshes every {{seconds}} seconds.
live.off: Live updates are not available. The board refreshes every {{seconds}} seconds.

wardSearch.placeholder: Search wards by name or code
wardSearch.typeToSearch: Type part of a ward's name or code.
wardSearch.failed: Wards could not be searched. Try again.

reservePanel.heading: Reserve bed {{number}}
reservePanel.patient: Patient the bed is held for

done.released: The reservation on bed {{number}} is cancelled.
done.cleaning: Bed {{number}} is marked as being cleaned.
done.discharged: {{patient}} is discharged. The bed is being cleaned.

refused.reserved: That bed is held for another patient.
refused.patientHolds: That patient already has a bed held.
refused.changed: Someone else changed this bed first. The board has been refreshed; try again.
refused.admission: The bed or the admission changed first. The list has been refreshed; try again.

admissionsDescription: Patients admitted to the hospital, with their bed and doctor. Give a bed or move a patient from here.

discharge.heading: Discharge {{patient}}
discharge.description: This ends the inpatient stay and closes its encounter. The bed is set to being cleaned. It cannot be undone.

bill.blocked: The bill is not settled, and this hospital does not allow discharge until it is.
bill.confirm: I have checked the bill and the patient may be discharged with it unsettled.
bill.override: I may override the hospital's rule: discharge this patient with the bill unsettled.

reasons.draft_invoice: An invoice is still a draft.
reasons.balance_due: An invoice has a balance due.
reasons.excess_deposit: A deposit is held beyond what is due and has not been paid back.

discharge.billRefused: The bill of this stay is not settled, so the server did not discharge the patient. Open the stay's bill, or confirm if you may.
discharge.unsignedNotes: A note of this stay is still a draft. Sign or discard every draft in the consultation first, then discharge the patient.
discharge.notOpen: The stay's encounter is no longer open, so the patient cannot be discharged from here.
discharge.clearancePending: A clearance of this stay is still open. Ask the ward, the pharmacy or the laboratory to clear it.

moveReasons.step_down: Stepping down to a lower level of care

admit.heading: Admit a patient
admit.description: Choose the patient and a free bed. Admitting opens the inpatient stay.
admit.doctorHint: Your own profile when left empty.
admit.noBeds: No bed is free, so nobody can be admitted now.
admit.adviceHint: Why the patient is to be admitted and what to do first. Optional.
admit.phoneShort: Enter a phone number of at least 5 characters.
admit.depositHint: The amount only. It is taken at the billing counter.
admit.depositInvalid: Enter an amount, for example 5000 or 5,000.50.

refused.bed: That bed was taken first. Choose another.

census.heading: Inpatient census
census.description: Who is in the hospital now by ward and doctor, and how full the beds are.

history.heading: Bed history of {{patient}}
history.empty: This patient has not been in a bed yet.
history.price: {{price}} a day, {{amount}} for the days so far
history.billed_one: {{count}} billed day, {{amount}}, at the price of that day
history.billed_other: {{count}} billed days, {{amount}}, each at the price of its day
history.categoryChanged: A different bed category than before, so a different day price from this bed.

advice.label: Advice for the patient
advice.failed: The advice could not be saved. Try again.

clearances.heading: Clearances
clearances.required: Needed for this way of leaving
clearances.optional: Not needed for this way of leaving
clearances.failed: The clearance could not be changed. Try again.

summary.heading: Discharge summary
summary.unavailable: The discharge summary is not available.
summary.none: No discharge summary has been written for this stay yet.
summary.draftElsewhere: A draft is being written. It is shown here once a doctor has signed it.
summary.draftHint: write the summary, then sign it. A signed summary cannot be changed; later corrections are added as addenda.
summary.title: Discharge summary

hints.procedures: Operations and procedures done during the stay.
hints.results: Laboratory and imaging results that matter after discharge.
hints.medicines: What the patient goes home on, with doses.
hints.followUp: When and where to be seen again, and what to watch for.

confirm.title: Sign this summary?
confirm.description: Once signed, the summary cannot be changed. Later corrections are added as addenda.

template.label: Start the course from a template
template.replace: Replace the course with the template
template.failed: The template could not be loaded. Try again.

addendumForm.heading: Add an addendum
addendumForm.hint: The signed text stays as it is. An addendum is added below it with your name and the time.
addendumForm.label: Addendum

refused.conflict: Someone changed the summary first. Reload the page and try again.
refused.signed: The summary is already signed. Add an addendum instead.
refused.incomplete: Diagnoses and the course are needed before signing.
refused.notSigned: Only a signed summary can be printed or have addenda.
